style: Say in an easy-going, encouraging way, like a relaxed speech coach at rehearsal.
lines: Each card is one section. Type its signpost first, then its words. Then make its slide on the right.
Tap a slide kind, then tap its job. A slide should do something your voice can't.
This slide competes with you. Cut its words, or tap a different job.
These are only your signposts. Type the talk's point in the Listener test box from them alone.
Tap Add section and set its role to Other side. Then answer it.
Press Start and talk out loud. Press Next or Space at the end of each section.
The microphone only measures loudness. Nothing is recorded.
Each row shows your real pace. Find the fastest section, then type what you'll change.
Run saved. Write what you'll change, then run it again.
You ran over the limit. Find a section to cut or tighten.
Open Rehearse and press Start to make your first run.
Tap a section and adjust its words or planned seconds for this task.
Clock paused. Press Resume or P when you're ready to continue.
Watch the count. Talk when the clock starts. Abandon run cancels this trial.
Speak out loud. Press Next or Space at the end of this section.
Speak out loud. Press Finish run or Space at the end of this section.
Tap Compare with Claim to compare your sentence with the Claim card.
Compare the two points. Tap Back to desk to revise a signpost.
